name: Klaus Ziegler
bio:
Klaus Ziegler's motorsport journey began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1 races broadcast from Spielberg. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering at the Graz University of Technology, where he specialized in vehicle dynamics. Following graduation, Klaus spent several years as a race engineer for smaller European touring car teams, honing his technical skills and developing a keen understanding of the operational complexities of motorsport.

At Dick Johnson Racing, Klaus brings a detail-oriented and adaptable approach to his role as Head of Operations. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. His perfectionist tendencies, coupled with his ability to see the bigger picture, allow him to anticipate potential issues and proactively implement solutions. Klaus distinguishes himself through his unwavering reliability and commitment to ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of all aspects of the team's operations.
